faqs.question: How do I apply for admission?
variants: What are the steps to apply?
Where do I fill the application form?
faqs.answer:
Apply online on the admissions portal:
1. Register with your email and phone number.
2. Fill in the application form.
3. Upload your documents.
4. Pay the ₹1,000 application fee.
Your application number is emailed to you straight away.

faqs.question: Is there an application fee?
variants: How much is the application fee?
How much does the application form cost?
Do I have to pay to apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's ₹1,000, or ₹500 for SC/ST and PwD applicants. It's non-refundable and can be paid by UPI, card or net banking.

faqs.question: Can I apply offline?
variants: Can I submit a paper form?
Can I apply in person at the college?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paper forms are available at the admissions office (Block A, ground floor) on weekdays, 10 am to 4 pm. Applying online is quicker and lets you track your status.

faqs.question: How do I check my application status?
variants: How can I track my application?
Where can I see my application status?
faqs.answer: Log in to the admissions portal with your application number and date of birth. You'll also get an email and SMS whenever your status changes.

faqs.question: Can I edit my application after submitting it?
variants: I made a mistake in my application form
How do I correct my application?
Can I change details in the form?
How do I edit my form?
faqs.answer: Yes, until the application deadline: log in and choose "Edit application". After the deadline, email admissions@ashwood.example with your application number and the correction.

faqs.question: Is there an interview or group discussion?
variants: Do I have to give a GD or PI?
Is there an interview for admission?
faqs.answer: Only for the MBA. Shortlisted candidates are invited to a group discussion and personal interview in May. Undergraduate admission is based on entrance scores and Class 12 marks.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for B.Tech?
variants: What are the minimum marks for engineering?
faqs.answer: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths, at least 60% aggregate (55% for reserved categories), and a valid JEE Main score.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BCA?
variants: Can I do BCA without maths?
faqs.answer: Class 12 in any stream with Maths or Computer Science as a subject, and at least 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for MBA?
variants: Who can apply for the MBA?
Can final year students apply for MBA?
faqs.answer: A bachelor's degree in any subject with at least 50% marks, plus a valid CAT, MAT or CMAT score. Final-year students can apply and are admitted provisionally.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams are accepted?
variants: Do I need an entrance exam?
Which entrance test should I take?
faqs.answer: B.Tech: JEE Main. MBA: CAT, MAT or CMAT. BCA, BBA and B.Sc don't need an entrance exam; admission is based on Class 12 marks.

faqs.question: Is there reservation for SC, ST, OBC and EWS?
variants: Is there a quota for OBC students?
faqs.answer: Yes, seats are reserved as per government norms: 15% SC, 7.5% ST, 27% OBC (non-creamy layer) and 10% EWS, plus 5% for PwD applicants across all categories.

faqs.question: Can I apply before my Class 12 results are out?
variants: My results are not declared yet
I'm appearing for Class 12 this year
Can I apply while awaiting results?
faqs.answer: Yes. Apply with your Class 10 marks now, then upload your Class 12 marksheet once results are out, before document verification.

faqs.question: What courses do you offer?
variants: Give me the list of courses
What can I study at the college?
faqs.answer:
Undergraduate: B.Tech (Computer Science, AI & Data Science, Electronics, Mechanical), BCA, BBA and B.Sc (Physics, Maths, Computer Science).
Postgraduate: MBA, M.Tech (Computer Science) and MCA.

faqs.question: How long is each course?
variants: How long does the MBA take?
faqs.answer: B.Tech: 4 years. BCA, BBA and B.Sc: 3 years. MBA, M.Tech and MCA: 2 years.

faqs.question: How many seats are there?
variants: How many students are in each batch?
faqs.answer: B.Tech CSE 180, AI & Data Science 120, other B.Tech branches 60 each. BCA 120, BBA 120, B.Sc 60 per subject. MBA 120, M.Tech 30, MCA 60.

faqs.question: Can I change my branch after the first year?
variants: Can I switch from mechanical to computer science?
faqs.answer: Yes, if there are free seats in the branch you want. Branch changes are decided by first-year CGPA, with a minimum of 8.0.

faqs.question: Do you offer part-time or distance courses?
faqs.answer: No. All programmes are full-time and taught on campus.

faqs.question: What is the fee for B.Tech?
variants: What is the engineering tuition fee?
How much do I pay per year for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: ₹1,40,000 a year in tuition, plus a one-time ₹15,000 admission fee and a ₹10,000 refundable caution deposit. Hostel and mess are charged separately.

faqs.question: What is the fee for BCA, BBA and B.Sc?
variants: How much is the BCA fee?
faqs.answer: Per year: BCA ₹80,000, BBA ₹75,000, B.Sc ₹50,000. There's also a one-time ₹15,000 admission fee.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA?
variants: How much does the MBA cost?
What is the MBA tuition fee?
faqs.answer: ₹2,20,000 a year plus the one-time ₹15,000 admission fee. This covers study material and the yearly industry visit.

faqs.question: Can I pay the fees in instalments?
variants: Is there an EMI option for fees?
Can I pay the fee in parts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each year's fee can be paid in two instalments, in July and December. Paying the full year up front gets you a 2% discount.

faqs.question: Do you offer scholarships?
faqs.answer:
Yes:
- 50% tuition waiver for 95% or more in Class 12, or a JEE percentile of 98+
- 25% waiver for 90 to 95%
- Need-based aid if your family income is under ₹3 lakh a year
Government scholarships through the National Scholarship Portal are accepted too.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy if I cancel my admission?
variants: Will I get my fee back if I withdraw?
How do I cancel my admission?
faqs.answer: Cancel before 15 August for a full refund minus ₹5,000 processing. After that: 90% back before classes start, 80% within 15 days of the start, 50% within 30 days, and nothing after that.

faqs.question: Can I get an education loan?
variants: Do you help with bank loans?
How do I get a loan for the fees?
faqs.answer: The college doesn't lend money itself, but most banks offer education loans. The accounts office gives you the fee structure letter banks ask for within 2 working days.

faqs.question: Is hostel available?
faqs.answer: Yes. There are separate hostels for men and women on campus, with 2-sharing and 3-sharing rooms. First-year students get priority.

faqs.question: What is the hostel fee?
variants: How much does the hostel cost?
faqs.answer: ₹90,000 a year for a 3-sharing room or ₹1,10,000 for 2-sharing. That includes mess (4 meals a day), Wi-Fi, laundry and electricity.

faqs.question: Where is the college located?
variants: How do I reach the campus?
faqs.answer: Ring Road, Sector 12, Ashwood. The nearest metro station is Ashwood Central, 1.5 km away, and college buses run from there every 20 minutes.

faqs.question: Is there a college bus?
variants: How much is the bus pass?
faqs.answer: Yes, college buses cover 18 routes across the city. A bus pass costs ₹18,000 a year.

faqs.question: What facilities are on campus?
faqs.answer: A library open until 11 pm, Wi-Fi everywhere, labs for every department, a sports ground, gym and indoor courts, a medical room with a nurse 24/7, a cafeteria and an ATM.

faqs.question: Is the campus safe? What about ragging?
faqs.answer: Ragging is strictly banned. There's an anti-ragging committee and a 24/7 helpline, and the campus has CCTV and security guards round the clock.

faqs.question: What documents do I need for admission?
variants: What should I bring for verification?
faqs.answer:
Bring:
- Class 10 and 12 marksheets
- Transfer certificate
- Entrance exam scorecard (if your course needs one)
- ID proof such as Aadhaar
- 4 passport-size photos
- Category certificate, if you're applying under a reserved category
- Income certificate, for need-based scholarships

faqs.question: When is document verification?
variants: What is the document verification date?
faqs.answer: Document verification is in the first week of July. Bring the originals and one set of self-attested photocopies.

faqs.question: Can I submit some documents later?
variants: My documents are not ready yet
What if a certificate is missing?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can take provisional admission and submit missing documents within 30 days of classes starting, along with an undertaking signed by a parent.

faqs.question: When do applications open?
variants: What is the application start date?
faqs.answer: Applications open on 1 February.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply?
faqs.answer: Undergraduate courses: 31 May. MBA: 30 April. Late applications are accepted until 15 June with a ₹500 late fee, if seats are left.

faqs.question: When will the merit list come out?
variants: When is the selection list published?
When will the results come out?
faqs.answer: The first merit list goes up on the portal on 10 June and the second on 20 June. You'll also get an email if you're selected.

faqs.question: When do classes start?
variants: What is the first day of college?
faqs.answer: Orientation is on 1 August and classes begin on 4 August.

faqs.question: How are the placements?
variants: What is the highest salary package?
Do companies come for campus recruitment?
faqs.answer: In the 2025–26 season, 86% of eligible B.Tech students were placed. The average package was ₹6.8 LPA and the highest ₹24 LPA, with 120+ companies recruiting on campus.

faqs.question: Do you help with internships?
faqs.answer: Yes. The placement cell arranges summer internships after the 2nd and 3rd years, and every student does a 6-week internship before the final year.

faqs.question: How do I contact the admissions office?
variants: What is the admissions phone number?
Can I talk to someone about admission?
faqs.answer: Email admissions@ashwood.example or call +91 00000 00000 (demo number), Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 6 pm. You can also visit the admissions office in Block A.

faqs.question: Can I visit the campus?
variants: Can I come and see the college?
How do I book a campus visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Campus tours run Monday to Saturday at 11 am and 3 pm. Book a slot on the admissions portal, or just walk in.
